author: Kushal
problem: Takahashi repeatedly walks A seconds at B meters per second and then rests C seconds; Aoki does the same with D, E and F. Both start together. Read A B C D E F X and print who has gone farther after X seconds: Takahashi, Aoki, or Draw.
bug_description: In Aoki's part the time of the full cycles is subtracted from z (his distance) instead of x, so Aoki's distance is wrong whenever X covers at least one full walk-rest cycle.

comments.accurate: Computes each runner's distance after X seconds from full walk-rest cycles plus the partial cycle, then compares
comments.wrong_behavior: Compares distances after X seconds, with Aoki's total reduced by the length of his completed cycles
comments.wrong_location: Aoki's cycle arithmetic verified; check Takahashi's partial-cycle branch when the leftover time equals A
